contract:
docs/architecture.md section 6.1 (verbatim):
- One process serves everything. apps/server serves the API under /api/* and, when WEB_DIST names a directory (a relative path resolves against the repository root, since pnpm --filter starts the server in apps/server), the built apps/web (vite build -> apps/web/dist) as static files at /. A GET for any other non-/api path returns index.html (SPA fallback). /api/* routes that don't exist stay JSON 404s. No CORS, since there's one origin. Local dev is unchanged: the Vite proxy, and no WEB_DIST.
- Health check: GET /api/health returns 200 { ok: true, engine: "ready" } once Stockfish has answered a shallow search (depth 1 on the start position, at most 5 s) and the store is open, and 503 { ok: false, reason } otherwise. It goes through the engine's normal queue (one search at a time per process), so it must stay cheap. Render's healthCheckPath points at it.
- render.yaml (coordinator-owned, already on main): buildCommand `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter @chess-tutor/web build`, startCommand `pnpm --filter @chess-tutor/server start`, healthCheckPath /api/health, env HOST=0.0.0.0, DB_PATH=/var/data/chess-tutor.sqlite, WEB_DIST=apps/web/dist; Render sets PORT.
Current code: apps/server/src/app.ts `buildServer(deps: ServerDeps)` with ServerDeps { bot, store, coaching?, newId?, now?, logger?, keepAliveMs? }; app.setNotFoundHandler returns 404 apiError(`no route ${method} ${url}`). main.ts builds `engine = createEngineFromEnv(...)` (StockfishEngine with analyze(fen, { depth, movetimeMs, multiPv })) and the store (createSqliteGameStore); apps/server/src/store.ts resolveDbPath shows the repo-root resolution pattern (fileURLToPath(new URL('../../../...', import.meta.url))). The GameStore interface may need an `isOpen`-style check, or the probe can run a trivial store read; your choice, inside apps/server.
